source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
1. Find all reports, models, and required documentation you'll need to take (start with the Incident reports).
2. Fill out all the forms (use the 'Form' file).
3. Open the FileExplorer program (start it with the 'file_explorer.py' file)
4. While in the File Explorer, search for the Incidents report.
5. After that, write your analysis report from that report. Use:
• The Incident Analysis Report (to document who was contacted, when) >> https://docs.w3health.com/en/11.5/incident_analysis_report.md
• The Report Template (to document the incident details) >> https://docs.w3health.com/en/11.5/report_template.md
6. Set the date and time to complete the report (use calendar).
7. Finish your report.
